title: Field notebook - inference mini-bench tracker (Ben)
content:
Quick field notebook for lightweight benching (personal tracker). Keep it short: goals, runs, anomalies, quick commands, and action items. Mostly rough notes to reproduce later.

Context: small investigations into quantized variants + prefix caching behavior for 8k-ish RL deployment prompts. Not a formal chase — fast triage and save commands here.

Legend: run_id | date | model | variant | batch | seq | quant | HW | p50_ms | p95_ms | tok/s | cost_unit | notes
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
r20250924-a | 2025-09-24 | redwood-7b | fp16 | 1 | 1024 | none | g4dn.12x | 74 | 210 | 2600 | 0.0009 | warm cache, baseline
r20250924-b | 2025-09-24 | redwood-7b | int8 | 1 | 1024 | ptq-int8 | g4dn.12x | 68 | 190 | 2850 | 0.0007 | slight quality degradation on rare tokens
r20251001-c | 2025-10-01 | redwood-13b | fp16 | 1 | 2048 | none | a100-80gb | 120 | 340 | 2200 | 0.0021 | KV cache hit after prefix.
r20251001-d | 2025-10-01 | redwood-13b | q4_0 | 1 | 2048 | q4_0 | a100-80gb | 96 | 270 | 2600 | 0.0015 | stable, see hallucination check
r20251112-e | 2025-11-12 | redwood-7b | int8 | 4 | 512 | ptq-int8 | g4dn.12x | 210 | 610 | 9800 | 0.0028 | batching helps but p95 worse for big tails
r20251203-f | 2025-12-03 | community-13b | q8_0 | 2 | 1024 | q8_0 | a10x | 160 | 450 | 3200 | 0.0010 | cheap hw, watch quality slump on numeric tasks
r20260205-g | 2026-02-05 | redwood-13b | q4_0+cache | 1 | 2048 | q4_0 | a100-80gb | 82 | 240 | 3000 | 0.0013 | prefix caching + q4 looks best tradeoff so far
r20260212-h | 2026-02-12 | redwood-13b | q4_0+cache | 1 | 4096 | q4_0 | a100-80gb | 150 | 520 | 1700 | 0.0014 | long context makes p95 explode, consider chunking

Quick observations (notes-to-self):
- q4_0 with prefix caching reduces p50 by ~30% vs fp16 while preserving most quality for our prompt set.
- Int8 (ptq) on 7b gives good throughput but occasional token-level issues; safe for low-risk tasks.
- Batching increases throughput but tail latency (p95) can worsen dramatically when variance in seq_len. Consider adaptive batch cutoff.
- Long contexts (>=4k) kick up memory pressure and p95; try sliding-window generation + KV eviction for big docs.

Repro commands (bench infra):
- run single: ./bench/run_infer.sh --model redwood-13b --variant q4_0 --seq 2048 --batch 1 --hw a100-80gb --cache-prefix true --out results/r20260205-g.json
- run sweep: python3 infra/sweep.py --cfg sweeps/q4_cache_sweep.yaml --out experiments/sweep-202602
- quick profile: python3 infra/profile_latency.py --input samples/prompt_set_small.json --model repo/redwood-13b --variant q4_0 --hw localhost

Quality checks (manual):
- small eval set (50 prompts) scored for factuality + token divergence vs fp16 baseline. Keep manual checks for runs marked with * in notes.
- run r20251001-d: flagged some numeric drift; sample seeds 10-50 need spot-checking.

Anomalies / hypotheses to investigate:
- why r20251112-e p95 jumps with batch=4: hypothesis = uneven seq_len distribution + delayed kv cache warm-up. Test by grouping by seq_len buckets.
- r20260212-h p95 growth: maybe small memory thrash + GC on the a100 driver side when context > 3k. Re-run with profiling and nvprof.

Immediate next actions:
- [ ] Re-run r20260205-g with the 80/20 prompt split to confirm q4_0 quality stability (owner: me). Target by 2026-02-25.
- [ ] Implement bucketed batching in bench infra; simple heuristic: group seq_len +/- 100 tokens. (ask Nora for quick patch)
- [ ] Add p99 sampling to logs for long-context experiments.
- [ ] Draft short one-pager on "q4_0 + prefix caching" and share with applied-ml for feedback (Liam to review).

Random scratch notes:
- Keep an eye on tokenization differences between repo tokenizer and HF tokenizer; saw ~0.2% diffs in training set when switching. Might affect cost calc.
- Quick prompt to reproduce drift: "Summarize the following financial policy and list actionable next steps for an engineer." Long context ~3.5k.

References (internal):
- Jira INFR-3421 (perf regression triage)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/bench-infra PR#78 (bucketed-batching WIP)
- Confluence: Bench/Latency Playbook notes (link above)

If I (Ben) am out: Nora knows the minimal reproduction steps. If both out, see bench-infra/owners.md for scheduled jobs.

End of notebook snapshot.
